idea: Simple ways to protect plumbing during renovation
title: Protecting Drain Stub-Outs During Renovation
description: Educational guide on preventing mortar and construction debris from clogging drainage systems during bathroom and kitchen remodels using mechanical expansion plugs.
image_prompt: A professional, high-detail vertical 9:16 photograph showing a close-up of a white PVC drain pipe stub-out protruding from a raw concrete bathroom floor during a renovation. Inside the open PVC pipe opening, a red rubber mechanical expansion test plug with a clean wing-nut handle is tightly installed, forming an airtight seal. The surrounding floor shows minor cement dust, tile spacers, and rough screed work, indicating active masonry construction, but the pipe opening is completely sealed and protected. Shot at a 45-degree angle with natural light, clean composition, crisp focus on the pipe and expansion plug, with generous uncluttered space at the top and bottom third for text overlays. Realistic plumbing materials, no text, no visual watermarks, no logos, no fake branding.
visual_story: The visual draws direct focus to an open PVC drain pipe sealed with a temporary mechanical expansion plug amidst a dusty construction environment. Viewers immediately notice the visual contrast between the messy tile prep environment and the clean, protected pipe interior. The plug prevents tile adhesive, grout, and concrete dust from dropping into the drain. This visual emphasizes that site preparation and pipe protection are standard professional practices, demonstrating how simple tools prevent catastrophic drain blockages before fixtures are installed.

on_image_text.hook: Stop Mortar From Ruining Open Drains
on_image_text.explanation: Tile mortar and grout settle in water-filled P-traps and harden into solid obstruction.
on_image_text.takeaway: Seal all exposed drain stubs with plugs before masonry work begins.
